main_text.l: QVA RATIONE VIRI PII certi esse possint de veritate professionis suæ?

Quæritur, Quæ sit tutissima via et ratio confirmandi animos piorum de veritate professionis suæ. ℞. Ad hoc idem responderi posset, quod dictum est suis locis, de mediis inquirendi genuinum scripturæ sensum, & decidendi controversias.

Verum, ut paulo felicius, quæ nobis præfiximus, scopū asequamur, summam eorum, quæ aliàs prolixè de hoc argumento disseruntur, complectemur, & dicimus: Si quis velit confirmari de professionis suæ veritate, & legitimè dijudicare controversias.
1 Faciat initium à precibus ad Deum.
2 Valere jussis[?] præjudiciis hoc unicum sibi proponat, ut erudiatur & confirmetur de dogmatum veritate ad Dei gloriam, suam salutem, aliorumq; exædificationem.

page.notes: The first letter Q of "Quæritur" is a large decorative initial, read as Q. The long s is printed as s throughout and is transcribed as s. The word after "Valere" in item 2 is only partly legible ("jussis"), so it is marked [?]. The small ornament at the right of the text block is a printer's mark and is not transcribed. The signature "1 2" at the foot is faint and may be read differently.
